title: In Yealink MeetingBoard Pro before 331.320.0.64, the Web management module has a front-end… (CVE-2026-122148)
description: Yealink MeetingBoard Pro versions before 331.320.0.64 contain a front-end validation bypass vulnerability in the Web management module. An attacker with administrator privileges on the local network can manipulate the page DOM to bypass UI control logic and invoke screenshot functions that are normally restricted. Exploitation requires a valid administrator account and local network access.
